description: This file provides utility functions for user authentication, including sign up, sign in, password reset, OAuth sign in, sign out, password update, and error handling, using the Supabase client.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, redirect URL is fixed for confirmation.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Sends a password reset email with a fixed redirect URL.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Signs in user via email magic link with fixed redirect.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Authenticates a user using an OAuth provider with a fixed redirect.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current authenticated user.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles authentication errors by providing user feedback and redirecting.
